criteria.reasoning: When the user later asks, "can you remind me what shipping address you have on that Galaxy Watch order?", the bot responds with "Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich", providing the shipping address again.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the transcript does the bot say it has lost access to prior data or tools; it consistently retrieves and presents the same order information when asked.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: For the follow-up question about the shipping address on the same Galaxy Watch order, the bot only restates the shipping address and does not re-list all order details or multiple orders.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: After the user specifies the Galaxy Watch order, the bot never asks again which order is being discussed and directly answers subsequent questions about that same order.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: All user requests (order timing, full details, and shipping address reminder) were answered accurately, completely, and specifically.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: There were no user indications of misunderstanding or pushback, so there were no repair opportunities mishandled.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referred to the same order, preserved all details correctly across turns, and recalled the shipping address when asked later.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was polite and natural throughout, though the closing 'Goodbye!' responses were a bit curt and formulaic rather than fully conversational.
